local __b64chars="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local __b64map={}
for __i=1,#__b64chars do __b64map[string.sub(__b64chars,__i,__i)]=__i-1 end
local function __b64decode(__s)
    __s=__s:gsub("[^%w%+/%=]","")
    local __out={}
    for __i=1,#__s,4 do
        local __a=__b64map[__s:sub(__i,__i)] or 0
        local __b=__b64map[__s:sub(__i+1,__i+1)] or 0
        local __cch=__s:sub(__i+2,__i+2)
        local __dch=__s:sub(__i+3,__i+3)
        local __c=(__cch=="=" or __cch=="") and 0 or (__b64map[__cch] or 0)
        local __d=(__dch=="=" or __dch=="") and 0 or (__b64map[__dch] or 0)
        __out[#__out+1]=string.char(__a*4+math.floor(__b/16))
        if __cch~="=" and __cch~="" then __out[#__out+1]=string.char((__b%16)*16+math.floor(__c/4)) end
        if __dch~="=" and __dch~="" then __out[#__out+1]=string.char((__c%4)*64+__d) end
    end
    return table.concat(__out)
end

-- CLICK SOUND ADDON (visual-only, does not replace existing button events)
do
    local ClickSoundId = "rbxassetid://70452176150315"
    local function AddClickSound(btn)
        if not btn:IsA("GuiButton") or btn:GetAttribute("ClickSoundAdded") then return end
        btn:SetAttribute("ClickSoundAdded", true)
        local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
        snd.Name = "CuteClickSound"
        snd.SoundId = ClickSoundId
        snd.Volume = 0.32
        snd.PlaybackSpeed = 1.05
        snd.Parent = btn
        btn.Activated:Connect(function()
            if snd.IsPlaying then snd:Stop() end
            snd:Play()
        end)
    end
    for _,obj in ipairs(x:GetDescendants()) do
        AddClickSound(obj)
    end
    x.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        AddClickSound(obj)
    end)
end

                    sc.Name="TrueCompactUIScale"

                sc.Scale=SCALE
            end
        end
    end)

-- ===== FREE MAIN UI SCALE CONTROL (MOBILE ROBUST / FLOATING BALL UNCHANGED) =====
do
    pcall(function()
        local V=(getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
        local root=V.DB_Ninja_V9_ReplacementRoot
        if not root then return end

        local MIN_SCALE,MAX_SCALE,STEP=0.55,1.00,0.05
        local EXCLUDE={RestoreMini=true,MiniBallLayer=true,DBNinjaScaleControl=true}
        local function applyScale(value)
            value=math.clamp(tonumber(value) or .78,MIN_SCALE,MAX_SCALE)
            value=math.floor(value/STEP+0.5)*STEP
            value=math.clamp(value,MIN_SCALE,MAX_SCALE)
            V.DB_NINJA_MAIN_SCALE=value
            for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("GuiObject") and not EXCLUDE[obj.Name] then
                    local sc=obj:FindFirstChild("TrueCompactUIScale")
                    if not sc then
                        sc=Instance.new("UIScale")
                        sc.Name="TrueCompactUIScale"
                        sc.Parent=obj
                    end
                    sc.Scale=value
                end
            end
        end

        local old=root:FindFirstChild("DBNinjaScaleControl")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        -- Small, touch-friendly controller. It uses buttons rather than drag-only input,
        -- so it works reliably on mobile executors as well as mouse/keyboard.
        local panel=Instance.new("Frame")
        panel.Name="DBNinjaScaleControl"
        panel.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1)
        panel.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-16)
        panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(250,48)
        panel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,32,62)
        panel.BackgroundTransparency=.12
        panel.BorderSizePixel=0
        panel.ZIndex=100000
        panel.Parent=root.Parent
        local pc=Instance.new("UICorner");pc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,16);pc.Parent=panel
        local ps=Instance.new("UIStroke");ps.Thickness=1.5;ps.Color=Color3.fromRGB(130,210,255);ps.Transparency=.12;ps.Parent=panel

        local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
        title.BackgroundTransparency=1
        title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0)
        title.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(62,48)
        title.Text="大小"
        title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,248,255)
        title.TextSize=14
        title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.ZIndex=25001
        title.Parent=panel

        local minus=Instance.new("TextButton")
        minus.Name="ScaleMinus"
        minus.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(76,7)
        minus.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,34)
        minus.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,105,190)
        minus.BorderSizePixel=0
        minus.Text="−"
        minus.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(240,250,255)
        minus.TextSize=20
        minus.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        minus.AutoButtonColor=false
        minus.ZIndex=25002
        minus.Parent=panel
        local mc=Instance.new("UICorner");mc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,11);mc.Parent=minus

        local valueLabel=Instance.new("TextButton")
        valueLabel.Name="ScaleValue"
        valueLabel.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(118,7)
        valueLabel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(62,34)
        valueLabel.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(30,67,120)
        valueLabel.BorderSizePixel=0
        valueLabel.Text="78%"
        valueLabel.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(130,225,255)
        valueLabel.TextSize=14
        valueLabel.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        valueLabel.AutoButtonColor=false
        valueLabel.ZIndex=25002
        valueLabel.Parent=panel
        local vc=Instance.new("UICorner");vc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,11);vc.Parent=valueLabel

        local plus=Instance.new("TextButton")
        plus.Name="ScalePlus"
        plus.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(184,7)
        plus.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(36,34)
        plus.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,105,190)
        plus.BorderSizePixel=0
        plus.Text="+"
        plus.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(240,250,255)
        plus.TextSize=20
        plus.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        plus.AutoButtonColor=false
        plus.ZIndex=25002
        plus.Parent=panel
        local xc=Instance.new("UICorner");xc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,11);xc.Parent=plus

        local reset=Instance.new("TextButton")
        reset.Name="ScaleReset"
        reset.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(224,7)
        reset.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(18,34)
        reset.BackgroundTransparency=1
        reset.Text="↺"
        reset.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(170,220,245)
        reset.TextSize=18
        reset.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        reset.AutoButtonColor=false
        reset.ZIndex=25002
        reset.Parent=panel

        local function redraw()
            local value=math.clamp(V.DB_NINJA_MAIN_SCALE or .78,MIN_SCALE,MAX_SCALE)
            valueLabel.Text=tostring(math.floor(value*100+0.5)).."%"
            minus.TextColor3=value<=MIN_SCALE and Color3.fromRGB(100,130,155) or Color3.fromRGB(240,250,255)
            plus.TextColor3=value>=MAX_SCALE and Color3.fromRGB(100,130,155) or Color3.fromRGB(240,250,255)
        end
        local function change(delta)
            applyScale((V.DB_NINJA_MAIN_SCALE or .78)+delta)
            redraw()
        end

        minus.Activated:Connect(function() change(-STEP) end)
        plus.Activated:Connect(function() change(STEP) end)
        valueLabel.Activated:Connect(function() change(STEP) end)
        reset.Activated:Connect(function() applyScale(.78);redraw() end)

        -- Also allow direct tapping anywhere on the control to adjust by direction.
        panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local x=input.Position.X-panel.AbsolutePosition.X
                if x<70 then change(-STEP) elseif x>185 then change(STEP) end
            end
        end)

        applyScale(V.DB_NINJA_MAIN_SCALE or .78)
        redraw()
    end)
end

-- ===== ELITE GLASS / CYBER BLUE UI POLISH =====
do
    pcall(function()
        local V=(getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
        local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
        local root=V.DB_Ninja_V9_ReplacementRoot
        if not root or not root.Parent then return end

        local blue=Color3.fromRGB(75,170,255)
        local ice=Color3.fromRGB(190,235,255)
        local deep=Color3.fromRGB(10,28,58)

        local function corner(obj,r)
            if not obj or not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
            local c=obj:FindFirstChild("EliteCorner") or Instance.new("UICorner")
            c.Name="EliteCorner"; c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r); c.Parent=obj
        end

        local function stroke(obj,thick,trans)
            local s=obj:FindFirstChild("EliteStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
            s.Name="EliteStroke"; s.Thickness=thick; s.Transparency=trans
            s.Color=blue; s.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border; s.Parent=obj
        end

        local function gradient(obj)
            local g=obj:FindFirstChild("EliteGradient") or Instance.new("UIGradient")
            g.Name="EliteGradient"; g.Rotation=90
            g.Color=ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(38,82,135)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.45,Color3.fromRGB(17,43,82)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(7,21,45))
            })
            g.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.08),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.20)
            })
            g.Parent=obj
        end

        local function polish(obj)
            if not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
            local n=(obj.Name or ""):lower()
            if obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                if n:find("panel") or n:find("menu") or n:find("bar") or n:find("card") or n:find("window") or n:find("container") then
                    if obj.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
                        obj.BackgroundTransparency=math.max(obj.BackgroundTransparency,.16)
                        corner(obj,14); stroke(obj,1.1,.32); gradient(obj)
                    end
                end
            elseif obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                corner(obj,12)
                local s=obj:FindFirstChild("EliteButtonStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke")
                s.Name="EliteButtonStroke"; s.Thickness=1.1; s.Transparency=.30; s.Color=blue; s.Parent=obj
                if obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                    obj.TextColor3=ice
                    obj.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                end
            elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
                if n:find("title") or n:find("header") or n:find("name") then
                    obj.TextColor3=ice
                    obj.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
                end
            end
        end

        for _,o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do polish(o) end

        -- Elegant top highlight on the main visible surface.
        local host=nil
        for _,o in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if o:IsA("GuiObject") and o.Visible and o.AbsoluteSize.X>250 and o.AbsoluteSize.Y>120 then
                host=o; break
            end
        end
        if host then
            local line=host:FindFirstChild("EliteTopLine") or Instance.new("Frame")
            line.Name="EliteTopLine"; line.BorderSizePixel=0; line.BackgroundColor3=ice
            line.BackgroundTransparency=.70; line.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,8)
            line.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,2); line.ZIndex=math.max(host.ZIndex+1,5); line.Parent=host
            corner(line,2)

            local shine=host:FindFirstChild("EliteShine") or Instance.new("Frame")
            shine.Name="EliteShine"; shine.BorderSizePixel=0; shine.BackgroundColor3=blue
            shine.BackgroundTransparency=.94; shine.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.04,.08)
            shine.Size=UDim2.new(.92,0,0,1); shine.ZIndex=math.max(host.ZIndex+1,5); shine.Parent=host
        end

        -- Subtle animated border pulse; disabled on reduced-motion devices.
        local pulseToken={alive=true}
        V.DB_NINJA_ELITE_PULSE=function() pulseToken.alive=false end
        task.spawn(function()
            local phase=0
            while pulseToken.alive and root.Parent do
                phase=phase+1
                local a=(math.sin(phase*.035)+1)*.5
                for _,o in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if o:IsA("UIStroke") and o.Name=="EliteStroke" then
                        o.Transparency=.24 + a*.16
                    end
                end
                task.wait(.05)
            end
        end)
    end)
end


-- ================================================================
-- CYBER HUD UI UPGRADE: REAL VISIBLE ADVANCED COMPLETE INTERFACE
-- Keeps the floating catgirl ball untouched; only adds presentation UI.
-- ================================================================
pcall(function()
    local V=(getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
    local root=V.DB_Ninja_V9_ReplacementRoot
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end
    if root:FindFirstChild("CyberCompleteHUD") then return end

    local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
    local blue=Color3.fromRGB(55,155,255)
    local cyan=Color3.fromRGB(125,220,255)
    local white=Color3.fromRGB(235,248,255)
    local dim=Color3.fromRGB(130,170,205)

    local hud=Instance.new("Frame")
    hud.Name="CyberCompleteHUD"; hud.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); hud.BackgroundTransparency=1
    hud.BorderSizePixel=0; hud.ZIndex=100; hud.Active=false; hud.Parent=root

    local function corner(o,r)
        local c=Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r); c.Parent=o
    end
    local function stroke(o,t,a)
        local s=Instance.new("UIStroke"); s.Color=blue; s.Thickness=t or 1; s.Transparency=a or .25; s.Parent=o
    end
    local function grad(o)
        local g=Instance.new("UIGradient"); g.Rotation=90
        g.Color=ColorSequence.new{
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,Color3.fromRGB(17,52,91)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(.5,Color3.fromRGB(7,28,55)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(3,14,29))}
        g.Transparency=NumberSequence.new{
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.08),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,.20)}
        g.Parent=o
    end
    local function label(parent,text,pos,size,txtSize,col,font)
        local l=Instance.new("TextLabel"); l.BackgroundTransparency=1; l.Text=text
        l.Position=pos; l.Size=size; l.TextColor3=col or white; l.TextSize=txtSize or 12
        l.Font=font or Enum.Font.GothamSemibold; l.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        l.ZIndex=parent.ZIndex+1; l.Parent=parent; return l
    end
    local function panel(name,pos,size,z)
        local p=Instance.new("Frame"); p.Name=name; p.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
        p.Position=pos; p.Size=size; p.BackgroundColor3=deep; p.BackgroundTransparency=.16
        p.BorderSizePixel=0; p.ZIndex=z or 101; p.Parent=hud
        corner(p,16); stroke(p,1.2,.22); grad(p)
        return p
    end

    -- Top command/header strip
    local top=panel("CyberTopBar",UDim2.new(.5,0,0,42),UDim2.new(0,560,0,58),110)
    label(top,"NINJA",UDim2.fromOffset(20,10),UDim2.new(0,80,0,24),18,cyan,Enum.Font.GothamBlack)
    label(top,"// CYBER HUD",UDim2.fromOffset(88,13),UDim2.new(0,180,0,20),12,dim,Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    local status=Instance.new("Frame"); status.Position=UDim2.new(1,-150,0,16); status.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(122,26)
    status.BackgroundColor3=blue; status.BackgroundTransparency=.78; status.BorderSizePixel=0; status.ZIndex=111; status.Parent=top; corner(status,13)
    local dot=Instance.new("Frame"); dot.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,9); dot.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8); dot.BackgroundColor3=cyan; dot.BorderSizePixel=0; dot.ZIndex=112; dot.Parent=status; corner(dot,8)
    label(status,"SYSTEM ONLINE",UDim2.fromOffset(25,4),UDim2.new(1,-28,1,0),10,white,Enum.Font.GothamBold)

    -- Left glass navigation
    local left=panel("CyberLeftNav",UDim2.new(0,96,.5,0),UDim2.fromOffset(154,350),108)
    label(left,"CONTROL",UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),UDim2.new(1,-36,0,18),11,cyan,Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    label(left,"NINJA SYSTEM",UDim2.fromOffset(18,39),UDim2.new(1,-36,0,18),9,dim,Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    local items={"HOME","SCRIPTS","VISUAL","SETTING"}
    for i,name in ipairs(items) do
        local b=Instance.new("TextButton"); b.Name="Nav_"..name; b.AutoButtonColor=false
        b.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,70+(i-1)*54); b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,42)
        b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(9,35,67); b.BackgroundTransparency=(i==1 and .12 or .48)
        b.BorderSizePixel=0; b.Text="  "..name; b.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        b.TextColor3=(i==1 and white or dim); b.TextSize=10; b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.ZIndex=109; b.Parent=left; corner(b,11); stroke(b,1,(i==1 and .15 or .55))
        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(.12),{BackgroundTransparency=.10,TextColor3=white}):Play() end)
        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(b,TweenInfo.new(.12),{BackgroundTransparency=(i==1 and .12 or .48),TextColor3=(i==1 and white or dim)}):Play() end)
    end

    -- Right status/control glass
    local right=panel("CyberRightInfo",UDim2.new(1,-96,.5,0),UDim2.fromOffset(154,350),108)

    label(right,"LIVE MONITOR",UDim2.fromOffset(18,39),UDim2.new(1,-36,0,18),9,dim,Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    local function metric(y,title,value)

    local bottom=panel("CyberBottomRail",UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-24),UDim2.new(0,430,0,38),110)

    -- soft scanning highlight, decorative only

        end

end)
